name: ListEntries
description: A collection of ListEntry objects that represent all the items in a drop-down form field.
remarks: Use the ListEntries property to return the ListEntries collection. The following example displays the items that appear in the form field named "Drop1." Use the Add method to add an item to a drop-down form field. The following example inserts a drop-down form field and then adds "red," "blue," and "green" to the form field. Use ListEntries (Index), where Index is the list entry name or the index number, to return a single ListEntry object. The index number represents the position of the entry in the drop-down form field (the first item is index number 1). The following example deletes the "Blue" entry from the drop-down form field named "Color." The following example displays the first item in the drop-down form field named "Color."

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified ListEntries object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of list entries in the collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual ListEntry object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position or a String representing the name of the individual object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Name As String, [Index As Variant]) As ListEntry
methods.description: Returns a ListEntry object that represents an item added to a drop-down form field.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the drop-down form field item.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: A number that represents the position of the item in the list.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all items from a drop-down form field.
